source_policy: Fresh ideal hcp lattice and analytical molecular geometry; no previous POSCAR, CONTCAR or computed energies are imported.
lattice_status: Initial guesses only; optimize new bulk Mg before constructing production slabs.
workflow_policy: Only submit the fixed DAG once, each child depends on its own required new parent; no old job IDs or whole-parent-array dependencies; no automatic VASP retries.
limitations: One selected initial molecular adsorption geometry and one OH bridge motif per surface; not a global adsorption minimum search.
Vacuum neutral-slab endpoint thermodynamics, not a liquid-water electrode potential model.
0.0625, 0.125 and 0.25 nominal OH coverage are local hydroxylation, not a proven continuous protective film.
No NEB, AIMD, DOS/Bader sweep, MgH2 slab, Mg2Ca intermetallic or corrosion-rate prediction.
Surface Ca=1/16 top metal sites is not experimental mass fraction.
Reoptimize references under a single PBE setup; do not combine with old Ca energies.
Slab thickness, K mesh, dispersion and explicit-solvent effects remain future sensitivity checks.
